tmReference: TM 9-6115-749-10, WP 0010, Engine symptoms 1-9, 20, 23, 27 and fuel level warnings

options.label: DCS has no power — no lighted display
Engine cranks but fails to start [Fault 359: Fail to Start]
Engine fails to start [Warning/Fault 3663: Winterization Kit Failure to Heat]
Engine stops suddenly (DCS shows a fault code)
Engine starts but develops lower than rated speed
Engine will not shut down [Warning 1416: Fail To Shutdown]
Fuel level warning [1441 Low Fuel Level, 2937 Fuel Level Sensor Low, 2936 Fuel Level Sensor High]
[Warning 1417: Power Down Failure] shown longer than 10 min

m1030e-n1b.text: Does the DCS display light now?

m1030e-n2.text: Inspect the battery cables and connections. Are any loose, damaged, corroded, or disconnected?

m1030e-n2t.text: Battery cables and/or connections are loose, damaged, corroded, or disconnected. Notify field maintenance.

terminal.summary: No DCS power — battery cables/connections defective

m1030e-n3.text: Is the main DC circuit breaker in the OFF/TRIP position (WP 0005)?

m1030e-n3a.text: Reset the main DC circuit breaker
m1030e-n3a.actionText: Move the switch handle to ON to RESET the circuit breaker (one attempt only).

m1030e-n4.text: Did the circuit breaker return to OFF/TRIP after the single attempt?

m1030e-n4t.text: Main DC circuit breaker returns to OFF/TRIP after a single attempt to move to ON. Notify field maintenance.

terminal.summary: No DCS power — main DC circuit breaker will not stay ON

m1030e-n4b.actionText: Push the PANEL LIGHTS switch to determine if power has been restored.

m1030e-n5.text: Does the DCS indicate power is available (lighted display)?

m1030e-n5t.text: DCS still indicates no power available (no lighted display). Notify field maintenance.

m1030e-n6.text: Turn engine control switch to START
m1030e-n6.actionText: Turn the engine control switch to START position.

m1030e-n7.text: Does the engine crank and start?

m1030e-n7y.text: DCS power restored (panel lights / main DC circuit breaker reset); engine starts.

terminal.summary: No DCS power — restored by operator, engine starts

m1030e-c0.text: Which code does the DCS show?

m1030e-c0t.text: Engine fails to crank with no listed code. Not corrected by the listed corrective actions. Per WP 0009: "If a malfunction is not listed or is not corrected by the listed corrective action, notify field maintenance."

terminal.summary: Engine fails to crank — not listed/not corrected

m1030e-b1.text: Check battery charge on the DCS
m1030e-b1.actionText: Examine the [Battery] [Vdc] parameter on the DCS display.

m1030e-b2t.text: Battery is discharged (indicator in the red area of the DCS display). Notify field maintenance.

terminal.summary: Engine fails to crank — dead battery

m1030e-b3.actionText: Push the FAULT RESET switch to clear the fault on the DCS, then turn the engine control switch to START. If needed, attempt to start the generator set using the NATO slave receptacle (WP 0008, Emergency).

m1030e-b4.text: Did the engine start, and is the battery indicator out of the red area?

options.label: No — remains in the red area

m1030e-b4y.text: Fault 1443 cleared; engine started and battery indicator is not in the red area.

terminal.summary: Dead Battery fault — cleared, engine starts

m1030e-b4t.text: Battery indicator remains in the red area on the DCS display. Notify field maintenance.

m1030e-k1t.text: Faulty control, speed sensing, or starting system(s) [Fault 1438: Fail To Crank]. Notify field maintenance.

terminal.summary: Engine fails to crank — Fault 1438 Fail To Crank

m1030e-r1.text: Was the remote EMERGENCY STOP enabled intentionally?

m1030e-r2.text: Determine the cause. Can you restore from the cause (WP 0011)?

m1030e-r2t.text: Unable to restore from the cause of the EMERGENCY STOP. Notify field maintenance.

terminal.summary: Remote E-Stop — cannot restore from cause

m1030e-r3.actionText: Disable the remote EMERGENCY STOP (place the PC cursor over the EMERGENCY STOP command symbol and click or press ENTER). Push FAULT RESET at the DCS panel to clear the Remote E-Stop fault, then turn the engine control switch to START.

options.label: No — TM: proceed to next symptom

terminal.summary: Engine fails to crank — Remote E-Stop cleared

m1030e-e1.text: Was the local EMERGENCY STOP enabled intentionally?

m1030e-e2.text: Determine the cause. Can you restore from the cause (WP 0011)?

m1030e-e2t.text: Unable to restore from the cause of the EMERGENCY STOP. Notify field maintenance.

terminal.summary: Local E-Stop — cannot restore from cause

m1030e-e3.actionText: Pull the EMERGENCY STOP switch knob out to the extended position. Push FAULT RESET at the DCS panel to clear the Local E-Stop fault, then turn the engine control switch to START.

options.label: No — TM: proceed to next symptom

terminal.summary: Engine fails to crank — Local E-Stop cleared

m1030e-g1.text: Is the BATTLESHORT switch in the ON position?

m1030e-g2.actionText: Move the BATTLESHORT switch handle to OFF. Push FAULT RESET at the DCS panel to clear [Warning 1131: Battleshort Active]. Turn the engine control switch to START.

m1030e-g3y.text: BATTLESHORT switch set to OFF; engine cranks.

terminal.summary: Engine fails to crank — BATTLESHORT turned OFF

m1030e-g3t.text: Engine fails to crank after BATTLESHORT switch set to OFF. Notify field maintenance.

terminal.summary: Engine fails to crank — not corrected

m1030e-f1.actionText: Perform WP 0016, Service Fuel System. Push FAULT RESET at the DCS panel to clear [Fault 359: Fail to Start]. Turn the engine control switch to START.

terminal.summary: Fail to Start — fuel system serviced

m1030e-f3.actionText: Perform WP 0014, Service Air Cleaner. Push FAULT RESET to clear [Fault 359: Fail to Start]. Turn the engine control switch to START.

terminal.summary: Fail to Start — air cleaner serviced

m1030e-f4t.text: [Fault 359: Fail to Start] reappears on the DCS display. Notify field maintenance.

m1030e-w1.text: Check cold weather starting aid status
m1030e-w1.actionText: Examine cold weather starting aid status on the DCS display ([Glw Plg] = air intake heaters). Turn the engine control switch to PRIME & RUN (or PRIME & RUN AUX FUEL if fuel is supplied from an auxiliary source). Observe coolant temperature on the DCS display.

m1030e-w2.text: Are coolant and ambient air temperatures below +20 °F (-6 °C)?

options.label: Yes — below +20 °F ([Not Ready To Crank] shown)
No — above +20 °F and cold start aids are activated

m1030e-w2t.text: Coolant and ambient temperatures are above +20 °F (-6 °C) and cold start aids are activated: move the main DC circuit breaker to OFF/TRIP and notify field maintenance.

terminal.summary: Winterization kit/air intake heaters activated above +20 °F

m1030e-w3.actionText: Wait until the [Ready To Crank] message appears after the allotted time shown on the DCS display, then turn the engine control switch to START.

m1030e-w4y.text: Engine started after the cold-start heat cycle completed.

terminal.summary: Cold start — engine started after Ready To Crank

m1030e-w4t.text: Engine fails to start after [Ready To Crank]. Notify field maintenance.

terminal.summary: Winterization Kit Failure to Heat — engine fails to start

m1030e-s1.text: Examine the fuel level indication on the DCS. Is [Fault 1918: Fuel Level Low] shown, the indicator in the yellow or red area, or (with no DCS indication) no fuel visible in the tank?

m1030e-s1a.actionText: Refill the fuel tank (WP 0016, Service Fuel System). Examine the DCS fault status line for additional faults and restore from them if possible (WP 0011); push FAULT RESET to clear each fault code. Turn the engine control switch to START.

m1030e-s2.text: Can the additional fault(s) be cleared, and does the engine keep running after START is released?

m1030e-s2y.text: Low fuel corrected (tank refilled); engine runs.

terminal.summary: Engine starts but stops — fuel tank refilled

m1030e-s2t.text: Unable to clear fault. Notify field maintenance.

terminal.summary: Engine starts but stops — fault cannot be cleared

m1030e-s3.actionText: Service the fuel filter/water separator (WP 0016, Service Fuel System). Turn the engine control switch to START.

m1030e-s4.text: Does the engine keep running after START is released?

m1030e-s4y.text: Engine starts but stops — fuel filter/water separator serviced. Corrected by the operator action authorized in the TM.

terminal.summary: Engine starts but stops — fuel filter/water separator serviced

m1030e-s5.actionText: Service the air cleaner element (WP 0014, Service Air Cleaner). Turn the engine control switch to START.

m1030e-s6.text: Does the engine keep running after START is released?

m1030e-s6y.text: Engine starts but stops — air cleaner serviced. Corrected by the operator action authorized in the TM.

terminal.summary: Engine starts but stops — air cleaner serviced

m1030e-s7.actionText: Examine the fault code on the DCS display. Restore from the FAULT if possible (WP 0011), pushing FAULT RESET to clear each code. Turn the engine control switch to START.

options.label: Engine starts but stops after START is released

m1030e-s8y.text: Fault condition restored by the operator (WP 0011); engine runs.

terminal.summary: Engine starts but stops — fault restored

m1030e-s8t.text: Fault cannot be cleared, or engine starts but stops after the START switch is released. Notify field maintenance.

terminal.summary: Engine starts but stops — not corrected

m1030e-x0.text: Which fault does the DCS operator screen display?

m1030e-x0t.text: Engine stopped suddenly with a code not listed for the operator. Not corrected by the listed corrective actions. Per WP 0009: "If a malfunction is not listed or is not corrected by the listed corrective action, notify field maintenance." (WP 0011 lists codes for field maintenance.)

terminal.summary: Engine stops suddenly — code not operator-correctable

m1030e-h1.text: Examine external cables and components, and (with the set stopped) the load connections in the output box, for signs of damage due to excessive heat and/or the odor of burned insulation. Any sign of heat damage?

m1030e-h1t.text: Sign of damage due to excessive heat. Notify field maintenance. Do not attempt to start the generator set; restart only on order of higher command or when field maintenance has examined and corrected the damage.

terminal.summary: Fault 1445: Short Circuit — heat damage found

m1030e-h2.actionText: Push FAULT RESET switch at the DCS panel to clear the fault. Turn the engine control switch to START position.

m1030e-h3y.text: Fault 1445: Short Circuit cleared; no heat damage; generator set operating normally.

m1030e-h3t.text: Fault 1445: Short Circuit not corrected. Notify field maintenance.

m1030e-o1.text: Examine external cables and components, and (with the set stopped) the load connections in the output box, for signs of damage due to excessive heat and/or the odor of burned insulation. Any sign of heat damage?

m1030e-o1t.text: Sign of damage due to excessive heat. Notify field maintenance. Do not attempt to start the generator set; restart only on order of higher command or when field maintenance has examined and corrected the damage.

m1030e-o2.actionText: Push FAULT RESET switch at the DCS panel to clear the fault. Turn the engine control switch to START position.

m1030e-o3.text: Is the generator set operating outside [Genset Current] parameters?

m1030e-o3y.text: Fault 1472: OverCurrent cleared; no heat damage; generator set operating normally.

m1030e-o3t.text: Fault 1472: OverCurrent not corrected. Notify field maintenance.

m1030e-lo1.actionText: Inspect engine oil level and add oil if necessary (WP 0017, Service Engine Oil). Push FAULT RESET switch at the DCS panel to clear the fault. Examine the [FAULT] status line for additional faults and restore from them if possible (WP 0011). Turn the engine control switch to START.

options.label: Engine starts but stops after the switch is released

m1030e-lo2y.text: Low oil corrected (oil added); engine runs.

terminal.summary: Fault 415 Low Oil Pressure — oil added, engine runs

m1030e-lo2t.text: Low oil pressure fault not corrected. Notify field maintenance.

terminal.summary: Fault 415 Low Oil Pressure — not corrected

m1030e-hc1.actionText: Examine coolant level visually and add coolant as required (WP 0015, Service Cooling System). Push FAULT RESET switch at the DCS panel to clear the fault. Examine coolant temperature on the DCS; when in the green area, turn the engine control switch to START.

m1030e-hc2y.text: Coolant added; high coolant temperature fault cleared.

m1030e-hc3.text: Clear ventilation and air flow paths
m1030e-hc3.actionText: Inspect ventilation and air flow paths and clear any obstruction. Push FAULT RESET switch at the DCS panel to clear the fault. Examine coolant temperature; when in the green area, turn the engine control switch to START.

m1030e-hc4y.text: Ventilation/air flow obstruction cleared; fault cleared.

m1030e-hc4t.text: High coolant temperature [Fault 151] reappears. Notify field maintenance.

terminal.summary: Fault 151 High Coolant Temperature — not corrected

m1030e-v1.text: Can the AC voltage reconnection switch handle be moved to the voltage position required for the configuration?

m1030e-v1t.text: Switch handle cannot be selected for the required configuration. Notify field maintenance.

terminal.summary: Voltage configuration fault — switch cannot be set

m1030e-v2.actionText: Move the switch handle to the required voltage position. Push FAULT RESET switch at the DCS panel to clear the fault. Turn the engine control switch to START.

m1030e-v3y.text: AC voltage reconnection switch set to the required position; fault cleared.

m1030e-u1.actionText: Push FAULT RESET switch at the DCS panel to clear the fault. Turn the engine control switch to START. Observe [FREQUENCY] on the DCS display.

m1030e-u3.actionText: Service the fuel filter/water separator (WP 0016, Service Fuel System). Push FAULT RESET switch at the DCS panel to clear the fault. Turn the engine control switch to START and observe [FREQUENCY].

m1030e-u4y.text: Fuel filter/water separator serviced; underfrequency cleared.

m1030e-z1.actionText: Push FAULT RESET switch at the DCS panel to clear the fault. Turn the engine control switch to START position.

m1030e-z2t.text: [Fault 234: Overspeed Shutdown] reappears. Notify field maintenance.

m1030e-rp1.actionText: Push FAULT RESET switch at the DCS panel to clear the fault. Examine the [Contactor] indication; if it does not show [Open], push the AC CIRCUIT INTERRUPT switch and re-examine.

m1030e-rp2t.text: [Contactor] does not indicate [Open]. Notify field maintenance.

terminal.summary: Fault 1459 Reverse Power — contactor will not open

m1030e-rp3.actionText: Turn the engine control switch to START. Examine the DCS fault status line for additional faults and restore from them if possible (WP 0011).

m1030e-rp4y.text: Reverse power fault cleared; contactor open; engine restarted.

m1030e-rp4t.text: Unable to clear fault(s). Notify field maintenance.

m1030e-hv1.actionText: Push FAULT RESET switch at the DCS panel to clear the fault. Turn the engine control switch to START. Observe [Genset Voltage] (Table 1: 120 V 1-phase 118-122 V; 120/240 V 1-phase 118-122/236-244 V; 120/208 V 3-phase 118-122/205-211 V).

m1030e-hv2.text: Is generator set voltage more than the maximum in Table 1?

m1030e-hv2y.text: High AC voltage fault cleared; voltage within Table 1.

m1030e-hv2t.text: Generator set voltage is more than the maximum in Table 1. Notify field maintenance.

terminal.summary: Fault 1446 High AC Voltage — not corrected

m1030e-lv1.actionText: Push FAULT RESET switch at the DCS panel to clear the fault. Turn the engine control switch to START. Observe [Genset Voltage] against Table 1.

m1030e-lv2.text: Is generator set voltage less than or more than the Table 1 parameters?

m1030e-lv2y.text: Low AC voltage fault cleared; voltage within Table 1.

m1030e-lv2t.text: Generator set voltage outside Table 1. Notify field maintenance and request instructions on continued operation; do not continue operation without them.

terminal.summary: Fault 1447 Low AC Voltage — not corrected

m1030e-l1.actionText: Examine the frequency indicator on the DCS. If less than rated, adjust to obtain rated frequency (WP 0005, Operation Under Usual Conditions).

m1030e-l2y.text: Low engine speed — frequency adjusted to rated. Corrected by the operator action authorized in the TM.

terminal.summary: Low engine speed — frequency adjusted to rated

m1030e-l3.actionText: Service the fuel filter/water separator (WP 0016, Service Fuel System). Turn the engine control switch to START.

m1030e-l4.text: Is the engine at rated speed now?

m1030e-l4y.text: Low engine speed — fuel filter/water separator serviced. Corrected by the operator action authorized in the TM.

terminal.summary: Low engine speed — fuel filter/water separator serviced

m1030e-l5.actionText: Service the air cleaner element (WP 0014, Service Air Cleaner).

m1030e-l6y.text: Air cleaner serviced; engine at rated speed.

terminal.summary: Low engine speed — air cleaner serviced

m1030e-l6t.text: Engine still below rated speed. Notify field maintenance.

m1030e-d1.actionText: Verify the engine control switch is OFF. If it is, push the EMERGENCY STOP switch on the engine control panel. If the engine continues to operate, open the right-side door and move the DEAD CRANK SWITCH toggle to OFF.

m1030e-d2t.text: Engine stopped only by EMERGENCY STOP / DEAD CRANK SWITCH after failing to shut down. Notify field maintenance.

terminal.summary: Fail To Shutdown — engine stopped, needs field maintenance

m1030e-d3t.text: Engine continues to operate. Notify field maintenance.

terminal.summary: Fail To Shutdown — engine will not stop

options.label: [Warning 1441: Low Fuel Level] or [Warning 2937: Fuel Level Sensor Low]

m1030e-fl1.text: If the DCS fuel indicator is in the green area or shows no level, examine fuel level visually (WP 0016). Is fuel visible in the tank?

m1030e-fl1t.text: Fuel level is visible while the low-fuel/sensor warning is shown (faulty fuel level sensor). Notify field maintenance.

terminal.summary: Low fuel warning — fuel visible, sensor suspected

m1030e-fl2.actionText: Refill the fuel tank (WP 0016, Service Fuel System). Push FAULT RESET to clear [Warning 1441: Low Fuel Level].

m1030e-fl3y.text: Fuel tank refilled; low fuel warning cleared.

m1030e-fl3t.text: [Warning 1441: Low Fuel Level] reappears. Notify field maintenance.

m1030e-fh1.text: Note the fuel level reported on the DCS and examine the fuel level in the tank visually (WP 0016). Does the tank level correspond to the DCS?

m1030e-fh1t.text: Fuel level in the tank does not correspond to the level reported on the DCS. Notify field maintenance.

terminal.summary: Fuel Level Sensor High — sensor mismatch

m1030e-fh2t.text: Fuel level corresponds but [Warning 2936] is displayed (outcome not stated in the TM). Not corrected by the listed corrective actions. Per WP 0009: "If a malfunction is not listed or is not corrected by the listed corrective action, notify field maintenance."

terminal.summary: Fuel Level Sensor High — not corrected

m1030e-p1.actionText: Move the main DC circuit breaker handle to OFF/TRIP, then return it to RESET-ON. Turn the engine control switch to PRIME & RUN AUX FUEL or PRIME & RUN to reboot the processor. Push FAULT RESET to clear [Warning 1417: Power Down Failure].

m1030e-p2y.text: Processor rebooted; Power Down Failure warning cleared.

m1030e-p2t.text: [Warning 1417: Power Down Failure] reappears. Notify field maintenance.

terminal.summary: Warning 1417 Power Down Failure — not corrected

m1030x-q1.text: What color is the exhaust smoke?

m1030x-b1t.text: Engine emits blue exhaust smoke due to oil in combustion chambers. Notify field maintenance.

m1030x-w1.text: Inspect for evidence of water in the fuel tank, and inspect the fuel filter/water separator for contamination (WP 0016). Does contamination appear?

m1030x-w2.actionText: Drain the fuel filter/water separator (WP 0016, Service Fuel System). Turn the engine control switch to START.

m1030x-w3y.text: Fuel filter/water separator drained; white smoke stopped.

m1030x-w3t.text: White exhaust smoke continues. Notify field maintenance and request instructions on continued operation; do not continue operation without them.

m1030x-k1.text: Examine [GENSET CURRENT] parameters. Are they within limits (no high load condition)?

m1030x-k1t.text: High load condition with black smoke (corrective action not stated in the TM). Notify field maintenance and request instructions on continued operation; do not continue operation without them.

m1030x-k2.actionText: Service the air cleaner element (WP 0014, Service Air Cleaner). Turn the engine control switch to START.

m1030x-k3y.text: Air cleaner serviced; black smoke stopped.

terminal.summary: Black exhaust smoke — air cleaner serviced

m1030x-k3t.text: Black exhaust smoke continues. Notify field maintenance and request instructions on continued operation; do not continue operation without them.

tmReference: TM 9-6115-749-10, WP 0010, Fault 415 Low Oil Pressure; Warning 143 Pre-Low Oil Pressure

m1030o-q1.text: Which code does the DCS show?

m1030o-f1.actionText: Inspect engine oil level and add oil if necessary (WP 0017, Service Engine Oil). Push FAULT RESET switch at the DCS panel to clear the fault. Examine the [FAULT] status line for additional faults and restore from them if possible (WP 0011). Turn the engine control switch to START.

options.label: Engine starts but stops after the switch is released

m1030o-f2y.text: Low oil corrected (oil added); engine runs.

terminal.summary: Fault 415 Low Oil Pressure — oil added

m1030o-f2t.text: Low oil pressure fault not corrected. Notify field maintenance.

terminal.summary: Fault 415 Low Oil Pressure — not corrected

m1030o-w1.text: Is the engine oil level below normal, or is an improper grade of oil for conditions suspected?

m1030o-w1t.text: [Warning 143] with correct oil level and grade (outcome not stated in the TM). Not corrected by the listed corrective actions. Per WP 0009: "If a malfunction is not listed or is not corrected by the listed corrective action, notify field maintenance."

m1030o-w2.actionText: Perform WP 0017, Service Engine Oil. Push FAULT RESET to clear the warning. If the engine was stopped to service oil, turn the engine control switch to START.

m1030o-w2y.text: Engine oil serviced (low oil); warning cleared.

m1030o-w2t.text: [Warning 143: Pre-Low Oil Pressure] reappears. Notify field maintenance.

m1030o-w4.actionText: Perform WP 0017, Service Engine Oil. Push FAULT RESET to clear the warning. If the engine was stopped to service oil, turn the engine control switch to START.

m1030o-w4y.text: Engine oil serviced (improper grade); warning cleared.

m1030o-w4t.text: [Warning 143: Pre-Low Oil Pressure] reappears. Notify field maintenance. Notify field maintenance and request instructions on continued operation; do not continue operation without them.

tmReference: TM 9-6115-749-10, WP 0010, Fault 151 High Coolant Temperature; Warning 146 Pre-High Coolant Temperature

m1030c-q1.text: Which code does the DCS show?

m1030c-f1.actionText: Examine coolant level visually and add coolant as required (WP 0015, Service Cooling System). Push FAULT RESET switch at the DCS panel to clear the fault. Examine coolant temperature on the DCS; when in the green area, turn the engine control switch to START.

m1030c-f2y.text: Coolant added; high coolant temperature fault cleared.

m1030c-f3.text: Clear ventilation and air flow paths
m1030c-f3.actionText: Inspect ventilation and air flow paths and clear any obstruction. Push FAULT RESET switch at the DCS panel to clear the fault. Examine coolant temperature; when in the green area, turn the engine control switch to START.

m1030c-f4y.text: Air flow obstruction cleared; fault cleared.

m1030c-f4t.text: High coolant temperature [Fault 151] reappears. Notify field maintenance.

m1030c-w1.text: Note the coolant temperature on the DCS, open the left-side access door and check the coolant overflow bottle. Is coolant visible (level midpoint between HIGH and LOW marks)?

m1030c-w1t.text: Coolant level is not visible. Notify field maintenance and request instructions on continued operation; do not continue operation without them.

m1030c-w2.text: Notify field maintenance and check air flow
m1030c-w2.actionText: Coolant level is visible: notify field maintenance (WP 0010 step 4). If the warning continues, inspect ventilation and air flow paths, clear any obstruction, and push FAULT RESET to clear the warning.

m1030c-w3y.text: Air flow paths cleared; Pre-High Coolant Temperature warning cleared (field maintenance notified per TM).

m1030c-w3t.text: [Warning 146] continues. Notify field maintenance and request instructions on continued operation; do not continue operation without them.

tmReference: TM 9-6115-749-10, WP 0010, AC output, battery, load, paralleling and GFCI symptoms

options.label: Battery warning [441 Low Battery Voltage, 1442 Weak Battery, 3662 Battery Discharge, 3663 Winterization Kit Failure to Heat]
[Warning 1457: Fail To Synchronize] or [Warning 3658: Switch Box Fail To Close]
Engine at speed but less than rated voltage
No power at GFCI CONVENIENCE RECEPTACLE

m1030l-vf1.text: Observe generator voltage. Does it settle within 30 seconds (transient) and stay within Table 1 limits?

m1030l-vfy.text: Voltage fluctuation was transient and voltage is within Table 1.

m1030l-vft.text: Voltage continues to fluctuate for more than 30 seconds. Notify field maintenance.

m1030l-vfo.text: Voltage is less than or more than the Table 1 values. Notify field maintenance and request instructions on continued operation; do not continue operation without them.

m1030l-ff1.text: Observe generator frequency. Does it fluctuate outside Table 2 limits (60 Hz: 59.5-60.5; 50 Hz: 49.5-50.5; 400 Hz: 399-401) for more than 15 seconds?

m1030l-fft.text: Frequency fluctuates outside Table 2 limits for more than 15 seconds. Notify field maintenance and request instructions on continued operation; do not continue operation without them.

m1030l-b1.text: Inspect battery cables and connections. Are any loose, damaged, corroded, or disconnected?

m1030l-b1t.text: Battery cables and/or connections are loose, damaged, corroded, or disconnected. Notify field maintenance.

m1030l-b2t.text: Cables serviceable: faulty battery-charging alternator. Notify field maintenance.

m1030l-kw1.text: Observe the DCS for a transient condition. Is the condition less than maximum [kW] output?

options.label: No — remains near or above maximum

m1030l-kw2.actionText: Push FAULT RESET to clear [Warning 1444: KW Overload].

m1030l-kw1t.text: Overload/over-current condition persists: continuously monitor coolant temperature. Notify field maintenance and request instructions on continued operation; do not continue operation without them.

m1030l-oc1.text: Observe the DCS for a transient condition. Is the condition less than maximum [Genset Current]?

options.label: No — remains near or above maximum

m1030l-oc2.actionText: Push FAULT RESET to clear [Warning 1471: Overcurrent].

m1030l-oc1t.text: Overload/over-current condition persists: continuously monitor coolant temperature. Notify field maintenance and request instructions on continued operation; do not continue operation without them.

m1030l-of1.actionText: Observe the DCS for a transient over-frequency condition. If it continues, adjust frequency to the required value on the DCS panel (WP 0005, Operation Under Usual Conditions).

m1030l-of2.text: Is frequency at the required value and the condition gone?

m1030l-of2y.text: Over-frequency was transient or frequency adjusted to the required value.

m1030l-of2t.text: Over-frequency continues or unable to adjust frequency. Notify field maintenance and request instructions on continued operation; do not continue operation without them.

m1030l-fc1.actionText: Observe the DCS for a change in selected frequency and adjust frequency to the required value on the DCS panel (WP 0005, Operation Under Usual Conditions).

m1030l-fc2.text: Was frequency adjusted to the required value?

m1030l-fc2y.text: Frequency adjusted to the required value.

m1030l-fc2t.text: Unable to adjust frequency to the required value. Contact field maintenance and request instructions on continued operation.

m1030l-sy1.actionText: Examine voltage and frequency options on the DCS and the AC voltage reconnection switches on each generator set; select voltage and frequency to match the required parameters (WP 0005). Repeat the paralleling task (WP 0006, Parallel Operation).

m1030l-sy2y.text: Paralleling parameters corrected; generator sets synchronized.

m1030l-sy2t.text: Paralleling warning (1457 or 3658) reappears. Notify field maintenance.

m1030l-rv1.actionText: Examine [GENSET VOLTAGE] on the DCS. If less than rated, adjust to obtain rated voltage (WP 0005, Operation Under Usual Conditions).

m1030l-rv2t.text: Unable to obtain rated voltage. Notify field maintenance.

m1030l-g1.actionText: Power is available from the GFCI CONVENIENCE RECEPTACLE only when the set is operating and [CONTACTOR] is [CLOSED]. With the set operating and the contactor closed, push the RESET switches on the face of the receptacle.

m1030l-g2.text: Is power available at the receptacle now?

m1030l-g2y.text: GFCI reset; convenience receptacle has power.

m1030l-g2t.text: Power still not available at the GFCI CONVENIENCE RECEPTACLE. Notify field maintenance.
